sections.title_zh: Fourier 分析中的振荡积分

visual_check.note: All ten pages rendered at 160 dpi and visually inspected. Pages 331-339 are text/formula/exercise/problem layouts; PDF 340 is the Chapter 8 title/epigraph/introduction page. No standalone teaching figures occur in this batch.

key_objects.name_zh: Cauchy-Szegő 核
key_objects.name_en: Cauchy-Szego kernel
key_objects.description: Here r(z,w) is holomorphic in z and conjugate-holomorphic in w, with r(z,z)=Im(z_n)-|z′|^2=-ρ(z).

key_objects.name_zh: Cauchy 积分公式
key_objects.name_en: Cauchy integral formula on U

key_objects.name_zh: Cauchy-Szegő 积分的再生性质
key_objects.name_en: reproducing property of the Cauchy-Szego integral
key_objects.statement: If F∈H^2(U) and F_0=lim_{ε→0}F_ε as in Theorem 8.1, then C(F_0)(z)=F(z).

key_objects.name_zh: Hardy 边界值的再生恒等式
key_objects.name_en: reproducing identity for Hardy boundary values

key_objects.name_zh: 固定 λ 的加权整函数空间
key_objects.name_en: weighted entire-function space at fixed lambda
key_objects.description: Entire functions f on C^{n-1} with ∫|f(z′)|^2 exp(-4πλ|z′|^2)dm(z′)<∞, for fixed λ>0.

key_objects.name_zh: 加权整函数空间的再生核恒等式
key_objects.name_en: weighted reproducing-kernel identity
key_objects.statement: For such f, f(z′)=∫ K_λ(z′,w′)f(w′)e^{-4πλ|w′|^2}dm(w′), where K_λ(z′,w′)=(4λ)^{n-1}e^{4πλ z′· ar w′}.

key_objects.name_zh: 加权整函数的再生公式
key_objects.name_en: weighted entire-function reproducing formula

key_objects.name_zh: Szegő 核的 Laplace 表示
key_objects.name_en: Laplace representation of the Szego kernel

key_objects.name_zh: Theorem 8.5 的 Fourier-Fock 证明机制
key_objects.name_en: Fourier-Fock mechanism in the proof of Theorem 8.5
key_objects.description: Insert the boundary Fourier representation from Proposition 8.3 into the Cauchy integral, use Lemma 8.6 in z′, then recover formula (33). Absolute convergence is justified by the improved F^δ_ε approximation before taking δ→0 and ε→0.

key_objects.name_zh: 不可解性
key_objects.name_en: Non-solvability
key_objects.description: Lewy’s basic example: local solvability of a tangential Cauchy-Riemann PDE forces an analytic-continuation condition on the Cauchy integral.

key_objects.name_zh: Lewy 型切向 Cauchy-Riemann 向量场
key_objects.name_en: Lewy-type tangential Cauchy-Riemann vector field
key_objects.formula: L=∂/∂ ar z_1 + i z_1 ∂/∂x_2  (equivalent conjugate convention is discussed in the text)

key_objects.name_zh: C^2 上半空间边界的 Cauchy 积分
key_objects.name_en: Cauchy integral on the C2 upper-half-space boundary

key_objects.name_zh: Cauchy 积分对分布的延拓
key_objects.name_en: extension of the Cauchy integral to distributions
key_objects.description: For compactly supported distributions f, the integral is interpreted by distribution pairing.

key_objects.name_zh: Lewy 局部可解性的解析延拓必要条件
key_objects.name_en: analytic-continuation condition for local Lewy solvability
key_objects.formula: C(f)(z) has an analytic continuation to a neighborhood of 0

key_objects.name_zh: Lewy 方程局部可解性的必要条件
key_objects.name_en: necessary condition for local solvability of the Lewy equation
key_objects.statement: If U is a distribution on C×R and L(U)=f in a neighborhood of the origin, then C(f)(z) must admit analytic continuation to a neighborhood of 0.

key_objects.name_zh: 光滑但局部不可解的 Lewy 右端项
key_objects.name_en: smooth right-hand side for which the Lewy equation is not locally solvable
key_objects.description: Choose a holomorphic F in Im(z_2)>0 that is C∞ up to the boundary and rapidly decreasing but not holomorphic across 0; set f=F|_{∂U}. Theorem 8.5 gives C(f)=F, violating (41), so L(U)=f is not locally solvable near 0.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 1：多圆盘内邻域消失推出恒等为零
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 1: vanishing near the center of a polydisc implies identically zero
key_objects.description: Use the power-series expansion from Proposition 1.1.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 2：多圆盘全纯域的对数凸性
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 2: logarithmic convexity of the polydisc domain of holomorphy
key_objects.description: (a) Interpolate radii by r_j≤σ_j^{1-θ}τ_j^θ; (b) deduce convexity after taking logarithms.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 3：一复变任意开集上的不可延拓全纯函数
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 3: a holomorphic function on any planar open set that cannot be analytically continued outside it
key_objects.description: Construct zeros approaching every boundary component using a discrete sequence.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 4：多复变有界区域中零集必达边界
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 4: a zero set in a bounded several-variable region must meet the boundary
key_objects.description: Use a one-variable slice through a zero point furthest from an exterior point.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 5：Cauchy-Riemann 基本解卷积的 Hölder 正则性与非 C1 例
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 5: Holder regularity and failure of C1 for convolution with the dbar fundamental solution
key_objects.description: Show u=f*Φ lies in Lip(α) for every α<1, but need not be C1.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 6：Cauchy-Green 公式及 Proposition 3.1 的另一证明
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 6: Cauchy-Green identity and an alternative proof of Proposition 3.1
key_objects.description: Verify the boundary-plus-area integral identity for C1 functions.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 7：紧支撑 dbar 解的矩条件
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 7: moment conditions for compact support of a dbar solution
key_objects.description: Compact support is equivalent to ∫_C ζ^n f(ζ)dm(ζ)=0 for every n≥0.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 8：定义函数的可除性与切向导数独立性
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 8: divisibility by a defining function and well-defined tangential derivatives
key_objects.description: If F vanishes on ∂Ω, write F=aρ; then tangential derivatives of boundary-equal extensions agree.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 9：Bochner 延拓与 Dirichlet 问题唯一性
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 9: Bochner extension and uniqueness for the Dirichlet problem
key_objects.description: Verify the extension in Theorem 4.1 is the unique Dirichlet solution with boundary data F0.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 10：Theorem 3.3 与 4.1 中连通性假设的必要性
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 10: necessity of the connectedness assumptions in Theorems 3.3 and 4.1
key_objects.description: Use the annular region {ρ<|z|<1}.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 11：外部连通、双侧 collar 连通性的等价
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 11: equivalence of complement and collar connectedness
key_objects.description: For small ε, prove equivalence of Ω^c connected, Ω_ε connected, and Ω^-_ε connected.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 12：平面 Dirichlet-Cauchy 边界数据的矩条件
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 12: moment condition for holomorphic extension of boundary data in one complex variable
key_objects.description: Show ∫_{∂Ω}z^nF0(z)dz=0 for all n≥0 is necessary and sufficient.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 13：Levi 规范形的进一步复坐标化简
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 13: further simplification of the Levi canonical form in complex coordinates
key_objects.description: Reduce the boundary to y_n=Σλ_j|z_j|^2+o(|z′|^2).

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 14：一复变边界点无局部全纯不变量
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 14: absence of local holomorphic boundary invariants in one complex variable
key_objects.description: Straighten a C^k curve holomorphically so its graph is flat to order k.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 15：不定 Levi 超曲面上的全局解析延拓
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 15: global analytic continuation from an indefinite-Levi hypersurface
key_objects.description: For M={Im z3=|z1|^2−|z2|^2}, show every nearby holomorphic F continues to all C^3 using Theorem 7.5 and rescaling.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 16：n=1 时局部极大值原理失效
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 16: failure of the local maximum principle when n=1
key_objects.description: Construct F_N=e^{N G(z)} from smooth boundary data and compare boundary and interior growth.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 17：上半空间的逆 Cayley 变换与 Heisenberg 对称
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 17: inverse Cayley transform and Heisenberg symmetries of the upper half-space
key_objects.description: Verify the inverse ball map, Heisenberg translations/group law, non-isotropic dilations, and unitary invariance.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 18：加权 Fock 空间 H_λ 与正交投影
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 18: weighted Fock spaces H_lambda and their orthogonal projection
key_objects.description: Show H_λ is trivial for λ≤0, complete for λ>0, and P_λ with K_λ is the orthogonal projection.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 19：Hardy-Fourier 空间 H 的完备性与 Cauchy 投影
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 19: completeness of H and the Cauchy integral as an orthogonal projection
key_objects.description: Prove H is Hilbert and C is the orthogonal projection of L2(∂U,dβ) onto H2 boundary values.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 1*：分别全纯推出联合全纯
key_objects.name_en: Problem 1*: separate holomorphy implies joint holomorphy
key_objects.description: No continuity assumption is needed; Baire category is an important ingredient.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 2*：Weierstrass 预备定理
key_objects.name_en: Problem 2*: Weierstrass preparation theorem
key_objects.description: After a linear change of variables, factor a holomorphic function near a zero as a nonvanishing factor times a monic polynomial in z_n.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 3*：Bochner-Martinelli 积分证明边界延拓
key_objects.name_en: Problem 3*: Bochner-Martinelli integral proof of boundary extension
key_objects.description: Original proof of Theorem 4.1 represents F from C1 boundary data using Green’s theorem.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 4*：伪凸域上的 dbar 方程与 dbar-Neumann 问题
key_objects.name_en: Problem 4*: the dbar equation and dbar-Neumann problem on pseudoconvex domains
key_objects.description: For smooth dbar-closed f on pseudoconvex Ω, solve dbar u=f; on strongly pseudoconvex domains the normal L2 solution is smooth.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 5*：全纯域与伪凸性
key_objects.name_en: Problem 5*: domains of holomorphy and pseudoconvexity
key_objects.description: A C2 domain of holomorphy is pseudoconvex; conversely pseudoconvex domains are domains of holomorphy.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 6*：Theorem 8.7 的逆命题与 Heisenberg 卷积相对逆
key_objects.name_en: Problem 6*: converse to Theorem 8.7 via a relative inverse on the Heisenberg group
key_objects.description: If compactly supported f has C(f) analytic near 0, then the Lewy equation is locally solvable; use a convolution relative inverse and Cauchy-Kowalevski.

key_objects.name_zh: 第 8 章 Fourier 分析中的振荡积分
key_objects.name_en: Chapter 8 Oscillatory Integrals in Fourier Analysis
key_objects.description: The chapter opens with historical remarks on oscillatory integrals, Fourier/Bessel examples, Airy, Lipschitz, Stokes, Riemann, stationary phase, Kelvin, and later lattice-point problems.

key_objects.name_zh: 振荡积分与驻相原理的历史动机
key_objects.name_en: historical motivation for oscillatory integrals and stationary phase
key_objects.description: Oscillatory-integral asymptotics have been central to harmonic analysis since Fourier. Early work of Airy, Lipschitz, Stokes and Riemann contains stationary-phase ideas, later used by Kelvin and in number-theoretic lattice-point problems.
